Background

I taught elementary school for five years, then led curriculum and academics for multi-campus school networks. My doctorate is in educational leadership. Most recently I have designed ELA courses and assessments for a K–12 network. That work belongs to my employer, so none of it appears here. Every sample in this section was written new for this portfolio. Full résumé.

How to read the labels

LabelWhat it means
Representative sampleNew material written for this portfolio to show how I work. It has not been used with students or clients.
Reviews real AI outputThe material under review was generated by an AI model from a recorded prompt and is shown unedited. The review is mine.
Simulated scenarioA realistic scenario. People, timelines and data are invented and say so.
Process sample, illustrative feedbackShows a process. Any example feedback is invented to illustrate it and is marked.

How I use AI

I use AI tools for drafting, research leads and checking, never as the final word. In WS7 and WS10, AI output is the thing being reviewed, so its errors are real and shown as generated. Everywhere else I set the design, wrote or rewrote the content, and checked every fact, standard and reference myself. No sample claims results with learners, because none has been used with learners yet.
